category: a game-server mode that permits automation bots
attribute: The mode is one where bots are deliberately permitted rather than banned as cheating, optionally limited to designated servers or account types.
attribute_note: "Maybe they can be certain servers or certain account types, like ironman." and "where they just allow bots"

category: an atomic (immutable, staged-update, boot-into-new-version) Linux desktop distribution
attribute: It combines the atomic property of updates staged invisibly in the background and adopted on next boot with the broad hardware, firmware and package support the asker values, on the other distribution family's base.
attribute_note: "I wish there was like a Debian but atomic that has broad support like Fedora does."

category: an image encoder usable inside a request-serving path
attribute: Encoding must be fast enough to run inline on large images — multi-second latency disqualifies it — so it is on-the-fly transcoding rather than a batch or command-line step.
attribute_note: "Is there a way to have fast on-the-fly WebP encoding" and "it was unusably slow multiple seconds for large images"

category: a way to load an existing agent's memory into a new session
attribute_note: Nothing beyond the category is asked for; the only added words are "because I don t want to start over fresh".

category: an application observability and telemetry instrumentation system
attribute: One set of annotations covers all three signals and the choice of signal per annotation is made at runtime and switchable live from a monitoring dashboard with a single click, instead of the signal type being fixed when the code is instrumented.
attribute_note: "let the ultimate decision to expose something as a metric x2F log x2F trace be dynamic at runtime" and "I should be able to just do that with a single mouse click"

category: a generator of study cards for spaced repetition
attribute: The cards are produced in bulk by the assistant from the material just read, instead of the learner typing them by hand into an app.
attribute_note: "is there a way to have Gemini make a bunch of cards for use with spaced repetition software"

category: a news feed client with tagging
attribute: Tagging applies to individual posts (labeling this type of post), where the asker's current client only permits tagging authors.
attribute_note: "I wish there was a way to tag this type of the posts, but at least my HN client allows to tag the authors."

category: a server-address discovery tool for a federated protocol
attribute: It must find a server's new canonical address when the old one is dead and the only surviving handle is the cryptographic identity, by locating entries signed with the same key.
attribute_note: "is there a way to find the new canonical PDS" and "you can theoretically index every log from everywhere and just look for new entries signed by the same key"

attribute: Play is reversible and guesses are not final: the player can undo and re-order guesses, or take a hint or reveal the solution, instead of each guess locking the board.
attribute_note: "Is there an Undo feature so I can back up and try a different order of guesses", "Can I get a hint", "give up and see the solution"

category: a reverse-proxy filter that can block or forward requests
attribute: Per request it chooses between blocking and proxying based on user agent, so scraper traffic can be deliberately forwarded onward to a chosen target while other traffic is served normally.
attribute_note: "a tool to actually send traffic to a tool like this" and "can block or proxy requests based on useragent"

category: a book/media library server that takes an existing local collection of files
attribute_note: Nothing beyond the category is asked for; the only words are "a way to bulk seed the books we DO have downloaded".

category: a project recommender driven by a user's own repository-star list
attribute: Recommendations are derived from the user's star history standing in for bookmarks that were lost, and are expected to reach projects almost nobody else has starred.
attribute_note: "I had lost my bookmarks once and I lost a lot of github projects so I decided to use stars as my bookmarks" and "nobody starred them so to show my support"

category: a C++ static analysis or linting tool
attribute: It enforces a chosen subset of the language, blocking outdated constructs and narrowing to one or a few accepted ways of doing things, rather than only reporting defects in ordinary C++.
attribute_note: "Is there anything like a linter to force you to stay within some subset of c++" and "hard to avoid language constructs that are outdated"

attribute: It is open source and lets the operator add custom storage backends or tiers, standing in for the extra storage classes the major cloud provider ships, instead of offering only a fixed set of storage classes.
attribute_note: "a good open source S3 alternarive that s easily extendable with custom storage backends" and "AWS offers IA and Glacier in addition to the defaults"

category: a hosted uptime and availability monitoring service
attribute: It costs roughly 25 cents per monitor per month, a self-serve consumer price, rather than an enterprise-oriented plan.
attribute_note: "I wish there was an uptime robot for like 25 cents a monitor a month" and "enterprise geared and too expensive for me to entertain"

category: an optional profile field linking a personal blog or social account
attribute: The field is opt-in and filled in by each person, and following works through it on the basis of declared overlapping interests, so discovery comes from interests rather than an existing follower graph.
attribute_note: "an optional field people could add so others with overlapping interests could follow a blog x2F socialmedia x2F etc."

attribute: The same interface that selectively stages changes also selectively splits them into separate commits, instead of staging serving only one commit.
attribute_note: "any tool that allows you to selectively stage can use the exact same interface to selectively split"

category: a maintained catalogue comparing currently available models
attribute: It tracks the newest releases continuously and reports per model the latest version, best use case, speed relative to a common baseline, and hardware needed to run it.
attribute_note: "some easy resource to keep up with the latest models" and "latest versions, best use case, performance in terms of speed relative to some baseline, and hardware requirements to run it"

category: a disk-usage analyser for a storage account
attribute: It reports where the space is going inside a cloud drive account rather than on a local filesystem.
attribute_note: "for google drive I really need something like this"
